scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @carwash/shared build && concurrently -k -n shared,backend,frontend -c gray,green,blue "pnpm --filter @carwash/shared dev" "pnpm --filter backend dev" "pnpm --filter frontend dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @carwash/shared build && pnpm --filter backend build && pnpm --filter frontend build
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c green,blue "pnpm --filter backend start" "pnpm --filter frontend start"
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter backend exec prisma migrate dev
